summary: Fizi territory (Sud-Kivu) is held by the government camp but with fragmented coercive control. Baraka and Fizi centre remain the main FARDC/state hubs, reinforced after the M23 advance on Uvira in December 2025, while Babembe Mai-Mai groups operating as Wazalendo dominate much of the Uvira-Baraka lakeshore road and the hills of Nundu. CNPSC/Yakutumba and allied Mai-Mai dominate the Ubwari peninsula, the Ngandja lakeshore south of Baraka, the Lulenge hills and most of the Kimbi-Lulenge hinterland, with the FARDC contesting the Misisi gold-mining area. The Banyamulenge high plateaux around Minembwe have been held by Twirwaneho, allied with AFC/M23, since February 2025. All zones are low confidence: no live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026. Review (2026-10-01): the reviewer could not do independent web research either (search budget exhausted; Wikipedia and ReliefWeb blocked). Zones were checked for consistency with the instructions and the neighbouring Uvira, Mwenga, Kabambare and Kalemie assessments. No controller changes; RED-Tabara presence was moved from the lakeshore and Ubwari zones to the Nundu hills, and the western Kimbi-Lulenge zone was lowered to unclear.

zones.description: Baraka-Fizi urban area on Lake Tanganyika (Baraka, Mwangaza, Mshimbakye, Katanga, Kalundja, Lweba, Kandali neighbourhoods) and adjoining lakeshore settlements Sebele, Malinde, Mulongwe, Kaseke, Ehanda, Asa'a, Mukinja, Kalongwe (Fizi HA)
zones.evidence: Baraka is the main FARDC/state hub of southern Sud-Kivu and became a rear base for FARDC and Burundian troops after the M23 push on Uvira in December 2025; Babembe Mai-Mai/Wazalendo groups are heavily present and have repeatedly clashed with or defied FARDC in the town, so control is shared/contested. Not verified for the reference date: no live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Fizi centre (territorial seat, Tribune/Fizi HA) and nearby Namisha
zones.evidence: Fizi centre hosts the territorial administration with an FARDC/PNC presence, while Mai-Mai (CNPSC/Yakutumba and allied Wazalendo) operate in the surrounding hills. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Lakeshore road north of Baraka, Nundu health zone (Nundu, Mboko, Elumbe/Kaboke, Lusenda refugee camp area/Atondo, Elemyonga/Mukolwe, Lubumba/Bitobolo, I'Amba/Makobola, Alole, Mukwezi, Kenya Plage)
zones.evidence: The Uvira-Baraka lakeshore road (Makobola, Swima, Mboko, Nundu, Lusenda) lies just south of the Uvira front; Babembe/Bafuliiru Mai-Mai operating as Wazalendo are assessed to dominate checkpoints and local enforcement alongside FARDC positions, with possible M23 pressure from the north since December 2025. Lusenda hosts a UNHCR Burundian refugee camp with police presence. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Western hills of Nundu HZ below the high plateaux (Lutabura, Nakiele, Kanguli, Tubuke/Kilumbi, Kosovo/Pungu)
zones.evidence: The mid-altitude hills between the lakeshore and the Banyamulenge high plateaux are Mai-Mai (Biloze Bishambuke/Ebu Ela, now Wazalendo) areas on the frontline with Twirwaneho; Burundian RED-Tabara rebels have historically used these hills. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Minembwe health zone, high plateaux (Ngandula / Kisombe)
zones.evidence: Twirwaneho, allied with AFC/M23, took Minembwe and pushed FARDC out of the Fizi/Mwenga high plateaux in February 2025 and has held the Banyamulenge plateau villages since, with Mai-Mai/Wazalendo contesting the edges. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Lulenge hills west of Fizi (Mukera, Kichula, Lumanya, Simbi, Kananda/Kanada, Umoja/Hondokuma, Bwala, Kilicha/Kalundu)
zones.evidence: The Lulenge secteur hills toward Itombwe are long-standing operating areas of CNPSC/Yakutumba and allied Babembe Mai-Mai (now aligned with Wazalendo), with little permanent state presence; Twirwaneho raids from the plateaux. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Ubwari peninsula and southern lakeshore / Ngandja (Mwayenga, Buma, Dine, Kazimia, Yungu, Talama, Kabanga/Nyemba, Kikonde: Kihimino, Lubilo, Kivunji, Mikweshi, Kaza Roho, Buma Kirewani, Kalongwe/Dine, Manjanja, Kabogo, Lusombe, Milanga, Kasaba, Yungu, Kibamba, Kizozi, Kikungu, Mapaypay)
zones.evidence: The Ubwari peninsula and the Ngandja lakeshore south of Baraka (Kazimia, Yungu, Talama) are the historical heartland of Mai-Mai Yakutumba (CNPSC), which taxes fishing and lake traffic; FARDC hold a few posts. CNPSC is now aligned with the Wazalendo against M23. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Misisi-Lulimba gold-mining area, Kimbi Lulenge HZ (Ebimbo/Misisi, Lekesha/Lulimba, Lubondja)
zones.evidence: Misisi is a large artisanal gold-mining town with FARDC and police presence, but CNPSC/Yakutumba and allied Mai-Mai have repeatedly attacked and taxed the Misisi-Lulimba area. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026.

zones.description: Southern and western Kimbi Lulenge HZ (Lubitchako/Ishebu, Tulonge, Ngalula, Makungu/Nyangi, Namukala, Kilembwe/Kituyka, Nessani/Kagembe, Maindombe/Nangoma, Kayumba/Magogo, May-Moto/Mwitilwa, Katupu/Asee, Sanga/Mukolochi)
zones.evidence: The forested Kimbi-Lulenge hinterland toward Kabambare and Shabunda is a CNPSC/Yakutumba and allied Mai-Mai operating area with minimal state presence. No live web research was possible for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/UN/KST sites blocked by the egress proxy); assessment rests on background knowledge up to mid-2026. Reviewer: status lowered from dominant to unclear because nothing documents which Mai-Mai faction (CNPSC, allied Babembe groups or Malaika near the Kabambare border) holds the western Kilembwe–May-Moto villages; this matches the neighbouring Kabambare assessment.
